meta.title: Flow Rate Converter — Convert Cubic m/sec and More
meta.description: Free flow rate converter for 5+ units including Cubic m/sec, Liter/sec, Liter/min. Instant, accurate, browser-based.

content.intro: Cubic meters/sec, liters/min, gallons/min. Fast, accurate conversions with engineering-grade precision for everyday and professional use. Convert between 5 flow rate units instantly, with engineering-grade precision and no signup required.
content.result_section: Pick any two units below to convert between them. The base unit for flow rate in this tool is **m3s**; every conversion routes through it for consistency.
content.formula_section: Most flow rate conversions are a single multiplication by a fixed factor. Temperature is the notable exception — it uses additive offsets, not just multiplication. The converter handles both transparently.
content.conversion_table:
| Unit | Symbol |
| --- | --- |
| Cubic m/sec | m³/s |
| Liter/sec | L/s |
| Liter/min | L/min |
| Gallon/min (US) | gpm |
| Cubic ft/min | cfm |
content.use_cases:
- Recipe scaling and bartending where measures span metric and imperial.
- Fuel economy comparisons across regions.
- Lab dosing and reagent prep across mL, L, and US/UK units.
- Aquarium, pool, and tank capacity calculations.
- Shipping fluid product specs across markets.
content.tips:
Bookmark the conversions you use most — each pair has its own dedicated page with formulas, a lookup table, and FAQs.

When working with derived units (area, volume), remember the factor scales with the dimension: a length factor f becomes f² for area and f³ for volume.
content.faq:
**Q:** How accurate is this flow rate converter?
**A:** It uses 5 canonical unit definitions and 12-digit precision constants.

**Q:** Is it free?
**A:** Yes — completely free, no signup, no limits.

**Q:** Which units are supported?
**A:** Cubic m/sec (m³/s), Liter/sec (L/s), Liter/min (L/min), Gallon/min (US) (gpm), Cubic ft/min (cfm).
